service.assembly: Power off. Release pod and access connector from rear; support glass independently. Pull drawer evenly on both ends, insert straight stiffener copper-up without force, close drawer before fastening pod. Remove Pi if needed for access.
service.operation_qualification: Envelope clears nominal structure; assembled finger access, pull force and complete physical latch travel are not qualified.

evidence: released assembly.step and exact CAD per-solid intersections

historical_route.scope: Historical negative clearance channels retained in screen parts; not the active installed mating route. Active PCB uses manufacturer-verified top-contact FH12A with-Y entrance.

historical_route.tail_exit_evidence: Sharp p26 stack: front target -1.4 minus front polarizer0.23 and glass0.6; assembly interpretation

bend.direction: behind panel, never toward front polarizer

connector.pin1_note: 180deg rotation about local Y reverses X; final PCB must map Sharp back-view pin1 against connector pin1, never copy a straight-tail footprint blindly

service.strain_relief: Non-contact U guard around fold; glass has its own retainer and connector must be anchored on future board. Guard does not clamp copper or glass bond.
